title: Codex-first model routing: fix broken enforcement layer
description: Codex delegation ran at ~3% of delegable work. Root causes: (1) $CODEX_PLUGIN never exported, so the documented readiness check errored and sessions invoked the fallback clause and worked inline; (2) the two routing hooks still encoded the pre-Codex table and ExitPlanMode actively instructed inline Opus builds; (3) hooks lived untracked outside cc-harness with no selftest; (4) no gate fired at the inline-edit moment.
design: Track hooks/ and scripts/ in cc-harness and link them via install.sh. Resolve the plugin root with a semver-aware resolver instead of an unset env var. Add a once-per-session first-edit gate. Every guard gets a falsifiable selftest.
acceptance_criteria: All selftests green at real exit codes; each proven red by mutation; a fresh headless session delegates to Codex instead of working inline.
close_reason: Implemented and verified: semver-aware plugin resolver + wrapper, Codex-first hooks (bd-ready, exitplan, new first-edit gate), install/uninstall symmetry guard, routing-report instrument. All 4 selftests green at real exit codes and each proven red by mutation. Behavioural A/B: pre-fix session worked inline on a false-negative readiness check; post-fix session delegated to codex:codex-rescue.

title: Codex dispatch protocol: job liveness = PID+log, per-workspace status, PID-bridge wait, placement check, cancellation criteria, completion contracts, broker housekeeping
description: Fold externally-supplied Codex/Claude integration advice into an always-loaded rule (rules/codex-dispatch-protocol.md), helper scripts (codex-wait.sh, codex-jobs.sh, codex-brokers.sh + selftest), the CLAUDE.md index/Model Routing table, and ~/.codex/config.toml sandbox writable roots. Verified against plugin 1.0.6 source: state dir is per-workspace under CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA/state/<slug>-<hash>, status filters on CODEX_COMPANION_SESSION_ID, liveness reconciles only 'running' via kill -0 on the worker PID.
